_doc: Gather wall-time baselines per machine fingerprint (GOOS-GOARCH-cpuN). Written by RECORD_GOLDEN=1, enforced by TestCorpusGolden within perfTolerance. A fingerprint with no entry means the gate does not apply on that machine — wall-clock is not comparable across hardware. Numbers may FALL freely; a rise is a reviewed diff, exactly like a judged floor.
